homepage.title: Pawché | Luxury Dog Accessories & Designer Dog Clothing
homepage.description: Elevate your dog's lifestyle with Pawché. Discover high-end pet accessories, designer dog clothing, luxury beds, and exclusive jewelry. Your dog lives for luxury too.
homepage.keywords: luxury dog accessories, designer dog clothing, high-end pet lifestyle, luxury dog beds, dog jewelry, luxury pet brand, designer pet accessories

the_wardrobe.title: Designer Dog Clothing & Couture Outfits | Pawché The Wardrobe
the_wardrobe.description: Shop the latest in designer dog clothing. From couture outfits to streetwear, find the perfect look for your stylish companion. Editorial-ready fashion for dogs.
the_wardrobe.keywords: designer dog clothing, couture dog outfits, luxury dog fashion, streetwear for dogs

the_vault.title: Exclusive Dog Jewelry & Designer Collars | The Vault by Pawché
the_vault.description: Discover the pinnacle of canine opulence in The Vault. Crystal-encrusted collars, gold-tone jewelry, and rare statement pieces for the dog who has everything.
the_vault.keywords: dog jewelry, designer dog collars, gold dog jewelry, crystal dog collars, luxury pet accessories

the_penthouse_suite.title: Luxury Dog Beds & Designer Pet Furniture | The Penthouse Suite
the_penthouse_suite.description: Experience the ultimate in comfort with luxury dog beds and designer furniture. Velvet loungers and premium crates that complement your high-end home decor.
the_penthouse_suite.keywords: luxury dog beds, designer pet furniture, high-end dog crates, velvet dog loungers

the_getaway.title: High-End Dog Carriers & Luxury Travel Bags | The Getaway
the_getaway.description: Travel in style with high-end dog carriers and luxury travel accessories. Airline-approved totes and car seat covers for the sophisticated pet traveler.
the_getaway.keywords: high-end dog carriers, luxury pet travel bags, designer dog totes, travel accessories for dogs

bowls_kitchen.title: Designer Dog Bowls & Luxury Feeding Stations | Bowls & Kitchen
bowls_kitchen.description: Elevated dining for pets. Explore designer dog bowls, marble feeding stations, and crystal water fountains. Because every meal should be a luxury event.
bowls_kitchen.keywords: designer dog bowls, luxury pet feeding stations, marble dog bowls, elevated dog feeders

the_spa.title: Premium Dog Grooming Kits & Luxury Spa Products | The Spa
the_spa.description: Pamper your pet with premium grooming kits and luxury spa products. Aromatherapy shampoos, silk robes, and high-end care for the refined dog.
the_spa.keywords: premium dog grooming, luxury dog spa products, dog aromatherapy, luxury pet care

the_accessory_bar.title: Designer Dog Collars, Leashes & Harnesses | The Accessory Bar
the_accessory_bar.description: Find the perfect finishing touches with designer collars, leashes, and harnesses. Luxury dog sunglasses, hats, and silk bandanas for a life lived beautifully.
the_accessory_bar.keywords: designer dog leashes, luxury dog harnesses, dog sunglasses, designer pet bandanas

the_sleep_suite.title: Plush Dog Beds & Luxury Sleeping Accessories | The Sleep Suite
the_sleep_suite.description: Indulge your pet with plush beds and orthopedic luxury mattresses. Silk-lined sleeping accessories designed for the ultimate beauty rest.
the_sleep_suite.keywords: plush dog beds, orthopedic luxury dog mattresses, silk dog blankets, luxury pet sleep accessories
